nodes.label: CI rust Job
nodes.rationale: fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-layers, check-deploy, check-strings and the full test suite against a live postgres:18 service pinned by digest.

nodes.label: check-strings Gate
nodes.rationale: Mangled line-continuations inside string literals are invisible to fmt, clippy and every test — fmt does not inspect literal contents — and reach operators as runtime error messages. That class recurred twice, so the gate exists; a gate that runs nowhere closes nothing.

nodes.label: Generated-File Staleness Gate
nodes.rationale: Uses `git status --porcelain`, not `git diff`, because the export deletes and recreates web/src/bindings — a type newly given #[ts(export)] produces an untracked file, and git diff never reports untracked files, so the stalest possible case would pass silently. The same gate covers AGENTS.md and web/src/routeTree.gen.ts.

nodes.label: Commit-Message Backstop Job
nodes.rationale: The local hook is bypassable with --no-verify and absent where setup never ran. Checks only the commits a push or PR adds: 148 commits predate the AI-attribution rule, so a job walking history would fail permanently and teach everyone to ignore it. Skips (saying so) on branch creation, rewritten history, or a range over 20 commits, which means a merge or batch import rather than new work.

nodes.label: cargo-deny CI Job
nodes.rationale: Runs the pinned EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action, enforcing the sources allow-list, licences and the SQL-confinement wrapper rule.

nodes.label: CI web Job
nodes.rationale: npm ci, typecheck, test, build on Node 24, then asserts the committed routeTree.gen.ts matches what the TanStack Router plugin generates.
